summary: Generic Claw MCP V1 is source-ready after current-head integration and non-regression; Claude remains the first live client.
reason: The earlier external write boundary is resolved. Current Claude Pro/Max connector documentation supports fixed request headers, so V1 uses per-client bearer auth and the existing outbound relay without adding OAuth or a provider-specific subsystem.

capabilities.reason: external_mcp is provider-neutral and read-only; admission is enforced on the exact route resolution, transport completion is projected to bounded business state, and artifacts require their originating client receipt.

architecture.reason: One external MCP adapter reuses the existing Cloudflare relay, Capability Harness/Graph, Remote Bridge receipts and Memory Core. Samantha remains on its local path; no second router, memory, scheduler, retry engine or OAuth server.

rollback: Disable/remove the MCP client secret or /mcp edge route, revert the scoped source commits, and restore the prior Companion release. Samantha, Slack Remote Bridge and RDC remain independent.
limitations: Real Claude custom-connector E2E and latency require deployment and account-side connector configuration.
V1 exposes only chat-owner-shadow read-only execution.
Four unrelated Python-suite failures reproduce identically on canonical main and are not fixed by this delivery.
